name: GPosson Columns Manager for Pods
author: gposson

sections.description:
Columns Manager for Pods is an essential extension for sites using the Pods framework.
It allows you to regain control over the administration tables of your Custom Post Types (CPT).

Features:
* Precisely select which columns to display.
* Modify column labels or widths.
* Make columns sortable.
* Add smart filters (dropdowns) on the columns of your choice.
* Export your filtered data in CSV format with full UTF-8 handling.
* Define a default sort order and criteria for each content type.

A modern interface allowing you to drag-and-drop your columns to precisely configure the desired output, without writing a single line of code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the file or folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the extension through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Settings > Columns Manager for Pods” to configure your columns, post type by post type.
sections.faq:
Is Pods Framework required to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin is an addon for the excellent Pods framework.
